svg.title: Replacement cost versus actual cash value
svg.desc: A labelled contents claim of 8000 dollars new can settle near 2500 dollars on actual cash value. The dwelling limit should be rebuild cost, not the listing price.
svg.text: Labelled contents example. Not a claim and not a premium. 23 Sep 2026.
Gap you fund: $5,500 on this sketch
Dwelling limit = rebuild cost. Market value includes land and is the wrong target.
Guaranteed replacement, if offered, still requires the insurer's calculator and reno notice.
Holdback: many RC wordings pay ACV first and the rest when you replace.
Ask if the roof, flooring match, or a water endorsement uses ACV anyway.
Education only. FCAC: compare coverage, not only price.
